description: This file contains functions related to licensing and environment configuration checks for Mattermost, including license validation, development mode detection, and cloud environment detection.

methods.name: IsEnterpriseLicensedOrDevelopment
methods.description: Checks if the server has any Mattermost Enterprise License or is in developer mode.

methods.name: isValidSkuShortName
methods.description: Validates if the license's SKU short name is among known valid options.

methods.name: IsE10LicensedOrDevelopment
methods.description: Checks if the server is licensed with E10 or Professional license, or in developer mode.

methods.name: IsE20LicensedOrDevelopment
methods.description: Checks if the server is licensed with E20 or Enterprise license, or in developer mode.

methods.name: IsEnterpriseAdvancedLicensedOrDevelopment
methods.description: Checks if the server has an Enterprise Advanced license or is in developer mode.

methods.name: IsConfiguredForDevelopment
methods.description: Determines if the server is in development mode based on configuration settings.

methods.name: IsCloud
methods.description: Checks if the server is running in a cloud environment based on license features.
